description: This file contains helper functions for encoding and decoding 3GPP RRC ASN.1 messages, including setup, reconfiguration, resume, and security mode command messages, with references to 3GPP specifications and ASN.1 structures.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_setup_msg
methods.description: Constructs an RRC setup message ASN.1 structure with cell config and SRB1 setup.

methods.name: get_transaction_id
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID from RRC setup complete or UL DCCH message.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_smc_msg
methods.description: Fills an ASN.1 security mode command message with specified algorithms and transaction ID.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_reconfiguration_msg
methods.description: Populates an ASN.1 RRC reconfiguration message with various configuration parameters.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_resume_msg
methods.description: Fills an ASN.1 RRC resume message with configuration data.
